subject.title: BL-ecommerce-catalog-13: lower max page hard cap to match the 500-result search window

question: Should the ecommerce catalog keep the current 500-result window and reject pages beyond `ceil(500 / perPage)`, or should the P1 SEO request to expand the window supersede this cap-lowering issue?
rationale: Both directions are open and affect SEO/client response behavior, so automation should not choose the permanent catalog pagination policy silently.

options.title: Reconcile before implementation
options.body: Pause code changes until Alex confirms whether this issue or https://github.com/Hamelyn-SL/hamelyn-serverless/issues/6604 owns the intended page-window behavior.

options.title: Keep 500-result window
options.body: Implement this issue as written, update the ecommerce catalog BL spec/test, and retarget the SEO expansion request accordingly.

options.title: Expand for SEO
options.body: Treat this issue as superseded by the 30,000-result SEO phase and update or close it after the expansion plan is accepted.

recommendation.title: Reconcile before implementation
recommendation.body: Pause code changes until Alex confirms whether this issue or https://github.com/Hamelyn-SL/hamelyn-serverless/issues/6604 owns the intended page-window behavior.
